entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: How often to poll fallback status, in milliseconds.

entry.name: preferredPlayer
entry.label: Player to prefer while it is playing. Empty means none. Part of the name is enough.

entry.name: player
entry.label: Player to follow and nothing else. Empty means auto-detect. Part of the name is enough.

entry.name: ignoredPlayers
entry.label: MPRIS players to never query, separated by commas.

entry.name: showTimestamp
entry.label: Prefix every line with its timestamp.

entry.name: showIcon
entry.label: Show a note icon next to the lyrics.

entry.name: showTrackInfo
entry.label: Show the current track in the tooltip.

entry.name: pauseWhenIdle
entry.label: Stop polling while nothing is playing.

entry.name: placeholderText
entry.label: Text shown when there are no lyrics.

entry.name: maxCharacters
entry.label: Maximum amount of characters shown in the panel. 0 means no limit.

entry.name: providerOrder
entry.label: Order of lyrics providers to query, separated by commas.

entry.name: localLyricsFolder
entry.label: Custom folder to search for local .lrc or .ttml files.

entry.name: customLyricsUrl
entry.label: Custom lyrics HTTP URL template with {title}, {artist}, {duration} placeholders.

entry.name: customLyricsHeaders
entry.label: Custom HTTP request headers (Name: value, newline separated).

entry.name: disabledProviders
entry.label: Disabled lyric providers, separated by commas.

entry.name: useSpicyLyrics
entry.label: Also ask the Spicy Lyrics API, which has word-level syncs for Spotify tracks.

entry.name: spicyKey
entry.label: Spicy Lyrics API key. Falls back to SPICY_LYRICS_SECRET_KEY in the environment.

entry.name: lyricOffset
entry.label: Shift the lyrics by this many milliseconds. Positive delays lyrics (if they are rushing ahead), negative shows them earlier.

entry.name: attributionLayout
entry.label: Attribution layout in the panel: Right or Below.

entry.name: wordStyle
entry.label: How the word being sung is marked: 0 is underline, 1 is bold, 2 is highlight color.

entry.name: pauseHideDelay
entry.label: Seconds of pause before hiding lyrics. 0 means keep lyrics visible.

entry.name: fadeTransition
entry.label: Smooth fade transition between lyric lines.

entry.name: clickAction
entry.label: Left click action: 0 for popup, 1 for play/pause.

entry.name: middleClickAction
entry.label: Middle click action: 0 for none, 1 for play/pause, 2 for next track.

entry.name: textAlignment
entry.label: Text alignment in panel: 0 for center, 1 for left.

entry.name: customHighlightColor
entry.label: Custom color for sung word and pause dots highlight. Empty means system accent color.

entry.name: blacklistedTracks
entry.label: List of artist - title pairs whose lyrics should be ignored (semicolon separated).
